tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: List the next open booking slots for a service at this business. Returns up to 3 slots with start/end times in the business timezone. Call before offering any time to the caller.

service.description: Service key from the price guide, e.g. aircon_service.

urgency.description: urgent = caller wants same or next day.

tools.name: book_job
tools.description: Book a confirmed slot into the business's job management system (ServiceM8, simPRO, Tradify, Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan or the clinic calendar). Only call after the caller has confirmed the slot, their name, mobile number and job address.

address.description: Job or patient address, as confirmed by the caller.

notes.description: Short job notes for the technician. No payment or health details beyond what is needed.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead / enquiry for a caller who is not ready to book, is outside hours, or needs a quote. Use for every missed call that leaves contact details.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what they need and when.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS to the caller (booking confirmation, missed-call text-back, or a callback promise). Max 480 characters. The business name is added automatically if missing.

tools.name: get_service_area
tools.description: Check whether a postcode (or Canadian FSA) is inside the business's service area.

tools.name: get_price_guide
tools.description: Return the approved price range for a service. These are the ONLY prices the receptionist may quote. If found=false, do not estimate.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Warm-transfer the call or page the on-call person. Use immediately for emergencies, complaints, a caller asking for a person, or anything outside policy.

summary.description: What the human needs to know before picking up.
